title: What If One Person Watched All of Netflix?
description:
What if one person watched every Netflix hour? Just six months' worth.

Sources:
- Netflix: What We Watched the First Half of 2025 (July 17 2025): https://about.netflix.com/en/news/what-we-watched-the-first-half-of-2025

Netflix reported over 95 billion hours watched from January to June 2025. 95 billion hours divided by 8,766 hours in a year = about 10.8 million years (our math). Not financial advice.

#shorts #netflix #whatif #howtheymakemoney
loop: So next time you hit next episode, ask yourself:
cta: Binge it or one a night? Comment below.
cta_question: Binge it or one a night?

scenes.narration: What if one person watched every Netflix hour? Just six months' worth.
Just January to June 2025. Over 95 billion hours.
Watching nonstop? That still takes about 10.8 million years.
And just one show, Adolescence, got 145 million views.
But that's the business. Netflix says more watching keeps members around.
